title: Analysis of RNA conformation in endogenously assembled RNPs by icSHAPE
protocol: Seed 3 × 10^4 HeLa or mouse embryonic stem cells in a 48-well plate one night before transfection.
Transfect reconstituted Cas9-sgRNA RNPs (20 pmol of Cas9 protein, and 20 pmol of sgRNA), together with 2 pmol of pcDNA-GFP, using 1.5 μL of Lipofectamine 2000 diluted in Opti-mem.
Co-transfect cells with the GFP-expressing vector.
Sort GFP-expressing single cells into two 96-well plates three days post-transfection.
Seed 1000 cells sparsely in a 10cm dish for cell cloning as an alternative method.
Pick single HeLa colonies after about 14 days for cell cloning.
Pick single mESC colonies after about 10 days for cell cloning.
Prepare cells for colony screening and freeze down a replicate plate.
Screen for KO clones based on the RBP expression using western blotting or immunofluorescence.
Design two PCR primer pairs: one inside amplicon to detect unedited alleles within the sgRNA cutting sites, another outside amplicon flanking the region to be deleted to detect edited alleles.
Identify successful homozygous deletion clones by negative inside amplicon and positive outside amplicon results.
Clone outside amplicon into a TOPO vector for further colony sequencing to examine exact genomic composition post-editing.
Genetically rescue the KO cell line with an epitope-tagged cDNA of RBP.
Clone cDNA of the RBP in-frame with an epitope tag into a lentiviral packaging vector such as pCDH-CMV-puro.
Propagate pCDH plasmids in Stbl3 strain with reduced recombination frequency.
Seed 293T cells one night prior to transfection at 50% confluency in a 10-cm dish.
Dilute pMDLg/pRRE (4.5ug) in 1 mL Opti-MEM.
Dilute pCMV-VSVG (2.5ug) in 1 mL Opti-MEM.
Dilute pRSV-Rev (1.5ug) in 1 mL Opti-MEM.
Dilute pCDH-tag-RBP-PuroR or control plasmid (7ug) in 1 mL Opti-MEM.
Resuspend 50 μL of lipofectamine in 1 mL OptiMEM.
Combine and mix contents from the four diluted solutions.
Incubate mixture at ambient temperature around 22°C for 20 minutes.
Add 2 mL cocktail to 293T cells in Opti-MEM.
Incubate under standard tissue culture conditions for 6 hours.
Replace dish with complete culture medium.
Collect first batch of culture medium 48 h post-transfection and store at 4°C.
Replenish remaining cells with fresh medium after collection.
Combine both supernatants 72 h post-transfection.
Pass combined supernatant through a 0.45 μM polyethersulfone filter using a syringe.
Do not use the 0.22 μM filter.
Add one-third volume of Lenti-X concentrator to viral supernatant for concentration.
Incubate at 4°C for 10–14 hours, protecting from light.
Spin concentrated viral particles at 1500 × g for 45 minutes at 4°C the next day.
Resuspend the visible viral pellet in 800 μL complete culture medium containing 10% FBS.
Directly apply the concentrated viral solution to infect target cell hosts.
Alternatively, aliquot the concentrated viral supernatants and snap-freeze for storage at -80°C.
Seed 5 × 10^4 cells per well of a 6-well plate with complete medium containing 10 μg/mL polybrene.
Incubate for 1 hour in the TC incubator.
Swirl-in 100 μL of concentrated viral solution into the culture medium.
Monitor GFP expression in GFP-transduced cells by 24 hours post-infection.
Begin antibiotic selection with 2 ng/μL puromycin at 48 hours post-infection or when most control cells become GFP-positive.
Maintain stable transgene expression by avoiding extensive passages and returning to low-passage stock.
Fractionate cells into a cytosolic extract “S100”, a high salt nuclear extract, and a DNase I-sensitive chromatin extract.
Pre-chill all tubes, homogenizers, and buffers before use.
Harvest cells and wash them with PBS.
Aspirate the supernatant thoroughly.
Measure the packed cell volume (PCV) after harvesting.
Ensure high viability (>95%) of starting cells.
Resuspend packed cells in 5× PCV of hypotonic Buffer A with gentle pipetting.
Incubate cell suspension on ice for exactly 10 minutes to let cells swell.
Spin down cells at 250 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant from the pellet.
Resuspend the pellet in 2× PCV of Buffer A.
Transfer the resuspended cells to a Dounce homogenizer.
Homogenize cell suspension with a loose pestle until 90% of cells are positively stained with Trypan Blue (0.2% final concentration) under a light microscope.
Spin down the homogenates at 25,000 × g for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Transfer the supernatant and add 11.1% (v/v) of glycerol and 11.1% (v/v) of Buffer B to reconstitute the final S100.
Centrifuge the S100 to pellet any insoluble debris if necessary.
Discard any leftover supernatant from the nuclei pellet with a pipette.
Add Buffer C to the nuclei pellet, swirl gently to resuspend, and transfer to a homogenizer.
Homogenize nuclei by a couple of strokes using a LOOSE glass pestle.
Pour the homogenates into a chilled beaker.
Choose a properly sized beaker for efficient mixing of the solution.
Drop-wise add 5M NaCl to the homogenate while maintaining gentle stirring.
Transfer the viscous and gooey pellet to a centrifuge tube.
Pour the nuclei suspension into an ultracentrifugation tube with care.
Gently rotate the tube for 30 min at 4°C.
Ultracentrifuge at 40,000 × g for 30 min at 4°C.
Aliquot and store the supernatant as the high salt nuclear extract.
Rinse the pellet with PBS twice.
Resuspend in DNaseI digestion buffer (400 Kunitz Unit/mL) proportional to starting cell number.
Gently rotate for 30 min at 37°C.
Spin down at 21,000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature.
Store the supernatant as the salt-resistant, DNase-sensitive chromatin-bound fraction.
Spin down the input extract at 21,000 × g for 15 min at 4°C.
Transfer the cleared supernatant to a new tube.
Wash Protein A-conjugated agarose beads with PBS twice.
Block the beads twice with nuclear buffer containing BSA (see materials and equipment), each with 10min rotation at 4°C.
Wash beads in nuclear buffer without BSA.
Prewash protein A beads by gently rotating at 4°C for 1 hour per 1mL of extract using 60 μL of prewashed beads at 50% slurry.
Pellet the beads at 7000 × g for 30 seconds at 4°C; transfer the supernatant to a new tube as the precleared nuclear extract.
Add 30 μg of purified anti-RBP antibody into 1mL of precleared nuclear extract.
Gently rotate at 4°C for 60 minutes.
Pipette 60 μL of the prewashed beads into the extract.
Gently rotate at 4°C for no more than 4 hours.
Wash four times with approximately 30 bead-volume of Lys450 buffer.
Alternatively, wash with NP150 buffer to preserve salt-sensitive components.
Wash an additional time with 1x direct assay buffer.
Resuspend the RNP-bound beads as a 50% slurry in 1x direct assay buffer with glycerol.
Snap freeze aliquots and store at -80°C.
Immobobilize the RBP onto its corresponding affinity resin.
Resuspend the resin in Nuclear Buffer420 w/ BSA containing 0.1 μg/μL RNase A, and gently rotate for 1 h at 4°C.
Wash the RBP-bound resin with a 100× bed-volume of Lys450.
Competitively elute the RBP from the resin by rotating in 1x direct assay buffer/glycerol containing 0.25 μg/μL peptide complementary to the affinity tag.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 min.
Reconstitute TCAB1, a WD40-containing RBP.
Decrease the icSHAPE signal at the “UGAG” box – terminal loop residues of the telomerase RNA.
Capture TCAB1’s footprint at the conserved CAB box important for telomerase localization in cells.
Reveal TCAB1’s distal structural footprints at P6.1 and P6b, two base-paired stem helices within the three-way-junction of the telomerase RNA.
Uncover structural dynamics specific to the RNP context by comparing with the structure of the naked RNA.
Generate the structure of the naked RNA in preparative steps 10–15.
Normalize the molar concentration of complexed RNA and IVT-RNA by northern blotting.
Equilibrate WT-RNP, KO-RNP, RNP + reconstituted RBP, and IVT-RNA at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Divide each fraction evenly into four reaction tubes.
Add NAI-N3 treatment to TUBE1.
Add NAI-N3 treatment to TUBE2.
Add 100 μM of NAI-N3 or an equal volume of DMSO to corresponding reaction tubes.
Incubate reactions at 37°C for 12 min in a thermomixer at 1000 rpm.
Stop reactions by addition of Trizol LS reagent.
Precipitate total RNAs and resuspend them in ddH2O.
Resuspend RNAs in 2.5× volume of 100% ethanol.
Purify RNAs using an RNA spin column.
Quantitate the purified RNAs with the Qubit RNA HS assay and agarose gel.
Construct a cDNA library for NGS sequencing.
Visualize icSHAPE reactivity at base-resolution onto an RNA secondary structure model using HiTRACE software package version 2.0.
